answer: Each identity posts a 0.10-unit escrow and a salted hash; a beacon fixed at block H+100 picks a 1% sample per epoch. Selected accounts reveal the salt and pass a probe in 50 blocks, or the escrow burns and the identity freezes 10 epochs; a wander audit reaches two referees per hit, and a lantern list publishes inspected accounts. A comet schedule triples sampling for identities under 12 epochs (sybils cluster early). An attacker with N identities pays 0.10*N upfront and burns about 0.01*N per epoch; after 10 epochs the burn equals the stake, so forging loses money.
